paragraphs.text: And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born unto them, that the angels of God saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare unto them sons and they were giants.
paragraphs.original: ויהי כי החלו בני האדם לרב על פני האדמה ובנות נולדו להם וירואו מלאכי האלהים בשנה אחת ביובל הזה כי טובות הן ויקחו להם נשים מכל אשר בחרו ותלדנה להם בנים והמה הגיברים
paragraphs.translit: wa-yhī kī hēḥēllū bənē hā-ʾādām lā-rōb ʿal pənē hā-ʾădāmāh ū-bānōt nōlədū lā-hem wa-yirʾū malʾăkē hā-ʾĕlōhīm bə-šānāh ʾaḥat ba-yōbēl ha-zeh kī ṭōbōt hēn wa-yiqqəḥū lā-hem nāšīm mi-kol ʾăšer bāḥărū wa-tēlaḏnāh lā-hem bānīm wə-hēmmāh ha-gibbōrīm

paragraphs.text: And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth -all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.
paragraphs.original: ወረሥሐት፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእስከ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኀደጉ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ወአኀዙ፡ ይትበላዕ፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡ ወአበሰ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ኂሩተ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኮነ፡ እኩየ፡ ዘልፈ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-rasḥat kwəlu śəgā fənoto ʾəm-nə sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska ʾarāwit wa-ʾəska ʾaʿwāf wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr kwəlomu ḫadagu śərʿatomu wa-ʾaḫazu yətballāʿ ʾaḥadu kāləʾo wa-ʾabasa ʿamaḍā lāʿla mədr wa-kwəlu ḫəllinā-hu la-kwəlu ḥirūta daqiqa sabʾ kona ʾəkkuya zalfa

paragraphs.text: And God looked upon the earth, and behold it was corrupt, and all flesh had corrupted its orders, and all that were upon the earth had wrought all manner of before His eyes. And He said that He would destroy man and all flesh upon the face of which He had created.
paragraphs.original: ወሤመ፡ እግዚእ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወአንሰ፡ አስተራኢ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ እምድኅረዝ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ካልአ፡ ምስለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኅሉፋን፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ዓመተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-śēma ʾəgziʾ manfasa lāʿla kwəlu sabʾ wa-ʾansa ʾastarāʾi lāʿla kwəlu śəgā ʾəmdəḫrazə kidāna kāləʾa məsla sabʾ la-mawāʿəl kwəlomu ḫəlufān məʾət wa-ʿaśrā ʿāmata

paragraphs.text: But Noah found grace before the eyes of the Lord. against the angels whom He had sent upon the earth, He was exceedingly wroth, and He gave commandment to root them out of all their dominion, and He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound in the midst of them, and are (kept) separate.
paragraphs.original: ወይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ አኀዝት፡ ምድር፡ ለመውዓ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ ገጸ፡ ምድር፡ ዘፈጠርኩ፡ እምሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወአዕዋፈ፡ ሰማይ፡ እስመ፡ ነስሕኩ፡ ከመ፡ ገበርክዎሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbē ʾəgziʾ ʾaḫaztu mədr la-mawʿā sabʾ ʾəm-nə gaṣṣa mədr za-faṭarku ʾəm-sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr wa-ʾaʿwāfa samāy ʾəsma nashku kama gabarkəwomu

paragraphs.text: And against their sons went forth a command from before His face that they should be smitten with the sword, and from under heaven. And He said 'My spirit shall not always abide on man; for they also and their days shall be one hundred and twenty years'.
paragraphs.original: ወአምልክት፡ ኖኅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ እግዚእ፡ ብርየ፡ ወብእሲ፡ ጻድቅ፡ በትውልዱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ፍጹም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾamləkta Noḫ qədma gaṣṣa ʾəgziʾ bərya wa-bəʾəsi ṣādəq ba-təwludu bəʾəsi fəṣṣum

paragraphs.text: And He sent His sword into their midst that each should slay his neighbour, and they began to slay each other till they all fell by the and were destroyed from the earth. And their fathers were witnesses (of their destruction), and after this they were bound in the depths of the earth for ever, until the day of the great condemnation, when judgment is executed on all those who have corrupted their ways and their works before And He destroyed all from their places, and there was not left one of them He judged not according to all their wickedness.
paragraphs.original: ወላዕለ፡ መላእክቲሁ፡ ኒሁ፡ እለ፡ ፈነወ፡ ኀበ፡ ምድር፡ ተምዕዐ፡ ጥቀ፡ ከመ፡ ይሰምኦሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ መካናቲሆሙ፡ ወሤሞሙ፡ ኀቤነ፡ ከመ፡ ናሰስሎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ጥልቅ፡ ዓለም፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ኩናኔ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-lāʿla malāʾəktihu naḫu ʾəlla fanawa ḫaba mədr tamʿəʿa ṭəqqa kama yəssamʾomu ʾəm-nə kwəlu makānātihomu wa-śēmomu ḫabēna kama nāsasələmu wəsta ṭəlq ʿālam ʾəska ʿəlata ʿabəy kwənnānē

paragraphs.text: And he made for all his works a new and righteous nature, so that they should not sin in their whole nature for ever, but should be all righteous each in his kind alway. And the judgment of all is ordained and written on the heavenly tablets in righteousness -even (the judgment of) all who depart from the path which is ordained for them to walk in; and if they walk not therein, judgment is written down for every And there is nothing in heaven or on earth, or in light or in darkness, or in Sheol or in the depth, or in the place of darkness (which is not judged); and all their judgments ordained and written and engraved.
paragraphs.original: ወላዕለ፡ ደቂቆሙ፡ ወፅአ፡ ቃል፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ከመ፡ ይትቀተሉ፡ በሰይፍ፡ ወከመ፡ ይስስሉ፡ እምነ፡ ታሕተ፡ ሰማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-lāʿla daqiqomu waḍʾa qāl ʾəm-nə qədma gaṣṣu kama yətqattalu ba-sayf wa-kama yəssaslu ʾəm-nə tāḥta samāy

paragraphs.text: In regard to all He will judge,the great according greatness, and the small according to his smallness, and each according to his way. And He is not one who will regard the person (of any), nor is He one who will receive gifts, if He says that He will execute judgment on each: if one gave everything that is on the earth, He will gifts or the person (of any), nor accept anything at his hands, for He is a righteous [And of the children of Israel it has been written and ordained: If they turn to him in righteousness He will forgive all their transgressions and pardon all their sins.
paragraphs.original: ወይቤ፡ ኢይነብር፡ መንፈስየ፡ በሰብእ፡ ለዓለም፡ እስመ፡ ሥጋሰ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወይኩኑ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ዓመተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbē ʾi-yənabbər manfasəya ba-sabʾ la-ʿālam ʾəsma śəgāsa ʾəmuntu wa-yəkunu mawāʿəlihomu məʾət wa-ʿaśrā ʿāmata

paragraphs.text: It is written and He will show mercy to all who turn from all their guilt once each year.] those who corrupted their ways and their thoughts before the flood, no man's person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account; for his heart was righteous in all his ways, according as it was commanded regarding him, and he had not departed from aught that was ordained for him.
paragraphs.original: ወፈነወ፡ ሰይፍ፡ በማእከሎሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበር፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡ ሰይፈ፡ ወአኀዙ፡ ይትቀተሉ፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡ እስከ፡ ወድቁ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በሰይፍ፡ ወአስተአተቱ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-fanawa sayf ba-māʾkalomu kama yəgbar ʾaḥadu kāləʾo sayfa wa-ʾaḫazu yətqattalu ʾaḥadu kāləʾo ʾəska wadqu kwəlomu ba-sayf wa-ʾastaʾtatu ʾəm-nə mədr

paragraphs.text: And the Lord said that he would destroy everything which was upon the earth, both men and beasts, and fowls of the air, and that which moveth on the earth. And He commanded make him an ark, that he might save himself from the waters of the flood.
paragraphs.original: ወአበዊሆሙ፡ ኮኑ፡ ይርእዩ፡ ወአስተአተቱ፡ እምድኅረዝ፡ በውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ ወአስተአተቶሙ፡ ካዕበ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ዘገብሩ፡ እኩየ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾabawihomu konu yərʾəyu wa-ʾastaʾtatu ʾəmdəḫrazə ba-wəsta mədr ʾəm-nə qədma ʾəgziʾ wa-ʾastaʾtatomu kāʿba lāʿla kwəlu gəbər zagabru ʾəkkuya

paragraphs.text: made the ark in all respects as He commanded him, in the twenty-seventh jubilee of years, in the in the fifth year (on the new moon of the first month). [1307 A.M.] And he entered in the sixth (year) thereof, [1308 A.M.] in the second month, on the new moon of the second month, till the sixteenth; and he entered, and all that we brought to him, into the ark, and the Lord closed it from without on the seventeenth evening.
paragraphs.original: ወአስተአተቶሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ መካናቲሆሙ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘተርፈ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ዘኢመነኖ፡ በከመ፡ መንኖሙ፡ በከመ፡ መጠን፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾastaʾtatomu ʾəm-nə kwəlu makānātihomu wa-ʾalbo zatarfa ʾəmənnehomu zaʾi-mannano ba-kama mannanomu ba-kama maṭan kwəlu gəbromu

paragraphs.text: And the Lord opened seven flood-gates of heaven, And the mouths of the fountains of the great deep, seven mouths in number. And the flood-gates began to pour down water from the heaven forty days and forty And the fountains of the deep also sent up waters, until the whole world was full of And the waters increased upon the earth: Fifteen cubits did the waters rise above all the high mountains, And the ark was lift up above the earth, And it moved upon the face of the waters.
paragraphs.original: ወገብረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ ወርትዐ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኬሐሉ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ በኵሉ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወከመ፡ ይኩኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጻድቃነ፡ በዘዘዚአሁ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ዘልፈ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-gabra lāʿla kwəlu gəbromu śərʿata ḥaddisa wa-rətʿa kama ʾi-yəkēḥalu la-ḫāṭiʾat ba-kwəlu śərʿatomu ʾəska la-ʿālam wa-kama yəkunu kwəlomu ṣādəqāna ba-zazazaʾahu gəʿz zalfa

paragraphs.text: And the water prevailed on the face of the earth five months -one hundred and fifty And the ark went and rested on the top of Lubar, one of the mountains of Ararat. And (on the new moon) in the fourth month the fountains of the great deep were closed and the flood-gates of heaven were restrained; and on the new moon of the seventh month all the mouths of the earth were opened, and the water began to descend into the deep below.
paragraphs.original: ወፍትሐ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዐቱ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ በከመ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ እምነ፡ ሕግ፡ ቦ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ ጽሑፋን፡ በከመ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ግብሮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-fətḥa kwəlu śəgā ṣəḥuf lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy ba-kama śərʿatu la-kwəlu gəbər ba-kama ṣədq wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw ʾəm-nə ḥəg bo wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw kwəlomu zawəstatēhā ṣəḥufan ba-kama kwəlomu gəbromu

paragraphs.text: the new moon of the tenth month the tops of the mountains were seen, and on the new moon of the first month the earth became visible. And the waters disappeared from above the earth in the fifth week in the seventh year [1309 A.M.] thereof, and on the seventeenth day in the second month the earth was dry.
paragraphs.original: ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትኀደግ፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ለርእሰ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ለመጠን፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘረሰየ፡ ወባሕቱ፡ ሊቀ፡ መንፈስ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ጻድቅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾalbo zayətḫaddag ʾəm-nə qədma gaṣṣu kwəlu gəbər la-rəʾəsa kwənnānē la-maṭan kwəlu gəbru lāʿla kwəlu zarassaya wa-bāḥtu liqa manfas la-kwəlu ṣādəq

paragraphs.text: And on the twenty-seventh thereof he opened the ark, and sent forth from it beasts, and cattle, and birds, and every moving thing. The Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha of the Old Testament by R.H. Charles, Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1913 Scanned and Edited by Joshua Williams, Northwest Nazarene College
